item.dc:creator: Sussan Ley
item.description: We are all always on the clock. It took 14 years to deliver Concorde, whereas today’s political cycle tends to reward whatever you can announce before the next election.
item.title: Concorde was an audacious plane. It could never be built now

item.dc:creator: David Swan, Vince Rugari
item.description: Players in Australia and New Zealand got the new GTA first - they’re also missing a feature overseas players have.
item.title: Weed yes, coke no: Aussies are playing a censored version of GTA VI

item.dc:creator: Stephen Bartholomeusz
item.description: Thanks to Donald Trump, Jensen Huang has made a triumphant return to Nvidia. But the world he is entering is vastly different from a few weeks ago.
item.title: Trump saved his billionaire mate but the walls may start closing in

item.dc:creator: David Swan
item.description: Reports of humiliated staff, a $1 million settlement and an alleged spy couldn’t keep Jensen Huang out. Silicon Valley’s founder worship is alive and well.
item.title: Jobs, Zuckerberg, now Huang. Tech still can’t quit its founder worship

item.dc:creator: David Swan
item.description: The co-founder of this $33 billion AI voice company started his career answering customers’ calls for an airline. Now he says those jobs will disappear.
item.title: Routine call centre work is finished, says AI company boss
